author: Divya Pai
text: Scott is a very straightforward, no nonsense guy. We had to get the calipers fixed on our car, and Scott offered the best rates in the area. The service was also pretty quick.

author: Shannon Mulford
text: I just had my transmission rebuilt by Scott's auto and they did an amazing job for a good price. My car has not run this well for three years — would definitely recommend.

author: Chance Barraclough
text: What a smart no nonsense guy. Really don't think there's a better mechanic in the Valley. Scott's replaced my Ford Edge's transmission, worked on my Honda and gonna do some work on my new Tundra I'm sure. Take it to Scott's not the dealership.

author: jann rupp
text: I highly recommend this auto and repair shop! I have been to them twice now and both times they have been fair and honest with me. They are friendly, trustworthy, competent and seem eager to help and problem solve car issues!

author: Mitch Potter
text: My wife's Subaru was having a timing issue with the wipers. I brought it to Scott's and they diagnosed the problem quickly and torqued a bolt in about 5 seconds that fixed it. They didn't charge us and we will definitely be coming back here for auto service.

author: Ron Dawson
text: Scott has always preferred good work on my vehicles. I had his shop replace the driveline on my 2014 VW Touareg — not an easy job. The cost was cheaper than another shop. They did a great job. Scott has always given me good solid advice.

author: Joseph Curry
text: My Ford F-150 needed a new Fuel Pump and a Timing Belt Replacement. Scott's Auto was very quick at diagnosing the problem and turning the truck around quickly. This is such a reliable, honest auto mechanic shop.

author: Chris McLaws
text: Scott gets my car done quickly and his prices are good. He only fixes what needs to be done and doesn't up-charge.

author: anthony ashcraft
text: Great shop! Knowledgeable staff. Fast service! They always make time for the unexpected repairs that need to be fixed quickly.

author: Captain SeaWolf
text: Scott is the best guy and best mechanic in Utah. He is also a great American. He is honest and does exceptional work.

author: Rich Watson
text: Honest and smart mechanic. Scott will explain what needs to be done. He replaced my water pump and my car is working perfectly! This was after taking it to 2 shops previous to Scott's. He will be my first option from now on. Saved me a ton of money, was honest in his assessment, and fast! 100% recommend!

author: Anthony L
text: I worked for Scott many years ago and he has always been a very magnanimous and honest person. He only lets honest mechanics work in his shop. He makes sure that good, quality work is performed. One hell of a guy, running an honest shop with good rates.

author: Hyde Nich
text: This guy is the best! Not only did he get my car done the same day, but when I couldn't pull it all the way there he came and pulled it with his own truck and son. He is so helpful — I'm a single mom and he really went out of his way for me.

author: Kyle S
text: I was in a bind and Scott got me in last minute and did some really quality work on my Subaru for a great price. Scott is a very honest and hardworking mechanic and I'm super grateful for his help! Highly recommend this place.

author: Damon Harris
text: I have been to Scott to fix my truck on numerous occasions and I have never had to go back because he didn't actually fix it. He fixes everything the first time, period. I will be going to Scott as long as I need help with my vehicle. And he charges decent prices.

author: Scott Garcia
text: Took my grandson's car in to have the clutch looked at. We thought it might need a new clutch. Scott explained the level of wear and thought it was premature to replace it. He could have just said it needed a new clutch, but he was honest about it.

author: Kaylee Jones
text: Scott is the best! Finishes the job quickly, prices are competitive, and he has great customer service. I've had nothing but good experiences here. Thanks for the rebuilt engine and install. I will be back for future needs!

author: B W
text: This guy did great work on a couple of things we had done on our vehicle. All in all great work.

author: Ryan Adams
text: I have taken my vehicles to many other mechanics before I found this place. They are absolutely the best — they won't give you the run around, they won't expect you to go find a bolt they broke. They stand behind their work.

author: Chris Meach
text: Scott does great work at a reasonable price. He is very quick and has impressed me on all vehicles that I have had him work on. He has done a transmission, a clutch and a head gasket on a few vehicles of mine.

author: Riley Sorensen
text: Scott is very well versed on cars and boats! Everything we need mechanically, he is our guy. He's honest, doesn't over charge, and only fixes what needs done. We will be back next time we need a mechanic!

author: Nick Kroncke
text: Scott was a great help. We couldn't get my problem sorted but he was generous with his time and help.

author: SAM Bila
text: When my previous mechanic told me my car could not be fixed I was desperate and about to get rid of it. But I found Scott, brought the car to him, and he fixed it. I am so happy and grateful.

author: Ryan Bierman
text: Excellent service. Scott has your best interest in mind and helps you find the best possible solution for your broken down vehicle. Very knowledgeable and you can trust your vehicle will be in good hands.

author: Weston Hansen
text: This was my second time using Scott's. The power steering went out in my truck. Scott got it in that day and had it fixed in a couple of hours. I couldn't recommend this shop more!

author: John Halliwill
text: My transmission and clutch went out. Another shop wanted $5,000 and had my car 2 weeks. I called Scott's and he did the job in 24 hours for $1,500. Thanks to people like Scott who help out. Thank you again!

author: Jay Scranton
text: Scott put a new clutch in my Jeep, got it done the same day for a really good price and got us back on the road. I would recommend him to anyone who asked!

author: Drew Miller
text: Scott is a great guy! Honest and to the point. Definitely saved me some money by not taking advantage of something I thought needed done. I will return.

author: Josiah Shepherd
text: Scott is a skilled mechanic who provides great service at a fair price. This is my go to place for car repairs.

author: Greg Van Dyke
text: Knew what he was doing. Diagnosed my truck's clutch in 15 mins. Picked up the part and I was on my way in an hour. Reasonable price, too.

author: Leonard May
text: Honest mechanic shop. Serviced my exhaust and got it right the first time.

author: Ken Nottingham
text: Excellent mechanic. We've used Scott for decades and keep coming back. Honest and friendly.

author: Crystal Nicole
text: Really great — brought me back to help me understand my truck better. He is awesome!

author: Nunya Business
text: Was on my way across the country and they took me in on short notice, diagnosed and fixed my issue in a few hours. Good price too.

author: Melissa Ward
text: So glad we found Scott's auto. Great, honest mechanic!

author: Bubba B.
text: Skilled, friendly, and cost-efficient. Will definitely bring other vehicles back.

author: Mark Dewyea
text: Scott's a great guy. Always there when the chips are down.

author: Jarod Weaver
text: Great place, affordable, great work and fast.

author: Carly Bierman
text: I'm never using a different auto-mechanic again!

author: Debbie White
text: This is my mechanic — he is great.

author: Kelly Coy
text: Fast and courteous! Fair priced!

author: Jason Bohn
text: Great service and great prices!

author: Jeremy Miller
text: Very helpful, best price.

author: Irvin Allen
text: Does a good job, in a timely manner.

author: Alan Tolman
text: Honest mechanic.

author: Eric Schmidt
text: Went in for an estimate on a brake issue I was having. Scott immediately took the time to look at my vehicle and offered to help shortly after he determined the issue. Was in and out in under an hour and was pleased with the level of work.

author: Elijah Fryman
text: Needed a new clutch quick and they got it done at a good price.

author: BATTLEZONE Gaming
text: I had a pretty good experience. They got me in pretty quick. They replaced my 2 front oxygen sensors, changed the front windshield washer fluid pump, and did a coolant flush. They allowed me to watch and explained what they were doing the whole time.

author: Taryn Owen
text: Took my car in, they analyzed it and gave me the possible problems and made sure I knew how much each step cost. They are very professional and will give you the best deal they can.

author: ANGEL RAFAEL OTERO
text: A good mechanic shop. Honest and gets the job done right.

author: Julie Gentillon
text: Positive: Punctuality, Quality, Professionalism, Value. Would highly recommend.
